source_evidence: Day327~15:43 exact player 'I am looking to expand my business to much more lucretive offerings, things that may not be accepted by official routes' explains broad commercial pretext but specifies no commodity, actual purchase, payment, arrangement, or admission of wrongdoing. Tavosk considers it, then draws a boundary around his own service. 'Then you are looking for a trading partner rather than a petition representative. I sell information. I don't arrange the purchase or sale of merchandise. Harthvale and his broker deal with freight. They would be better placed to tell you what business they are prepared to accept. I cannot speak for them.' This is a voluntary response within his established knowledge and role, not a new concession, evidence of specific prohibited cargo, claim that the association trades anything beyond established undeclared imports, or an introduction to an unrelated criminal enterprise. He declines to recommend a producer or buyer of unspecified prohibited goods and does not demand further explanation. No new roll is warranted for this ordinary statement of his own limits; prior admitted service, fee and paid commission remain unchanged. Mara/Cirren/Fenar hear the answer. No new suspicion of Watch investigation established, threat, expenditure, message, appointment, movement or custody change. V controls next action in Tavosk's office.
